Description: Runs the GitHub Copilot CLI as the coding agent of a workflow; the token reaches the agent container just-in-time.

Settings.Label: GitHub account
Settings.HelpText: A GitHub token with Copilot access. Connect… signs you in through the browser; a pasted token works too. Stored encrypted and never displayed back.

Settings.Label: Model
Settings.HelpText: Optional model override; the CLI's default model is used when empty.

Settings.Label: CLI path
Settings.HelpText: Path of the Copilot CLI executable inside the workflow image; only changed for testing.

settings.label: Interactive session (SDK)
settings.helpText: Run through the Copilot SDK for full interactivity: permission cards, questions, guidance, live model switch. Off = plain headless mode.
